levó: levar — he raised, lifted (preterite 3rd sg.; se levó en pie 'he rose to his feet'; with reflexive se, 'got up'; = levantó; modern levar is only 'to weigh (anchor)', llevar is 'to carry')
reçiba: reçebir — may he receive (present subjunctive 3rd sg., jussive; que reçiba derecho 'that he may receive justice'; = reciba)
tenido: tener — had, held (past participle after han; tuerto le han tenido 'they have done him wrong'; tener tuerto a uno 'to wrong someone', cf. tuerto me tovo; = tenido, closest hecho)
sabémoslo: saber + lo — we know it (present 1st pl. sabemos + enclitic lo, accent written; sabémoslo todos nós 'we all know it'; = lo sabemos)
alcaldes: alcalde — judge, arbiter (masc. pl., Arabic al-qāḍī; alcaldes sean desto 'let them be judges of this'; = alcaldes, now 'mayor')
vando: vando — party, faction, side (masc.; del vando non sodes 'you are not of the party'; = bando)
coñoscedores: coñoscedor — knowing, discerning, prudent (adjective, masc. pl., one form for both genders; ca sodes coñoscedores 'for you are discerning men'; = conocedores)
escoger: escoger — to pick out, single out (infinitive; por escoger el derecho 'to single out the right'; = escoger)
juro: jurar — I swear (present 1st sg.; juro par sant Esidre 'I swear by Saint Isidore'; = juro)
bolviere: bolver — (whoever) shall upset, overturn (future subjunctive 3rd sg.; el que bolviere mi cort 'he who shall disturb my court'; = volviere; the sense 'disturb' is our reading (?))
perderá: perder — he will lose (future 3rd sg., syncopated; perderá mi amor 'he will lose my favour'; = perderá)
toviere: tener — (whoever) shall have, hold (future subjunctive 3rd sg., strong stem; con el que toviere derecho 'with him who shall have the right'; quando las toviere 'when he has them'; = tuviere)
dessa: de + essa — of that, on that (contraction of de + esa, fem.; yo dessa parte me so 'I am on that side'; = de esa)
demande: demandar — let him ask, claim (present subjunctive 3rd sg., jussive; agora demande mio Çid 'now let my Çid make his claim'; = demande)
responden: responder — they answer (present 3rd pl.; qué responden 'what they answer'; = responden)
fiziestes: fazer — you did, made, held (preterite 2nd pl., -stes ending; esta cort fiziestes 'you made this court'; = hicisteis)
demando: demandar — I ask, claim (present 1st sg.; Esto les demando 'this I ask of them'; = demando)
sabredes: saber — you will know (future 2nd pl., syncopated, -edes ending; sabredes qué fer 'you will know what to do'; = sabréis)
sacaron: sacar — they took out, brought out (preterite 3rd pl.; sacaron las espadas 'they brought out the swords'; sacaron mis fijas de Valençia 'they took my daughters out of Valencia'; = sacaron)
diles: dar + les — I gave them (preterite 1st sg. di + dative les, with the enclitic after the verb; diles dos espadas 'I gave them two swords'; = les di)
ondrassen: ondrar — (that) they might honour (themselves) (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl. in -assen; ques ondrassen con ellas 'that they might win honour with them', ques = que + se; = honrasen, honrarse)
sirviessen: servir — (that) they might serve (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl. in -iessen; sirviessen a vos 'that they might serve you'; = sirvieran, sirviesen)
perdieron: perder — they lost (preterite 3rd pl.; perdieron mi amor 'they lost my favour'; = perdieron)
denme: dar + me — let them give me (present subjunctive 3rd pl. den + enclitic me, jussive; denme mis espadas 'let them give me my swords'; = que me den)
atorgan: atorgar — they grant, assent (present 3rd pl.; atorgan los alcaldes 'the judges assent'; = otorgan)
trayendo: traer — bringing along, carrying on (gerund, ir + gerund; apriessa lo ivan trayendo 'in haste they went carrying it on'; the exact sense is uncertain (?); = trayendo)
demanda: demandar — he asks, claims (present 3rd sg.; no nos demanda 'he does not claim of us'; quando las demanda 'since he asks for them'; = demanda)
abendremos: abenir — we shall agree, come to terms (future 1st pl., syncopated; bien nos abendremos 'we shall come to terms well with'; reflexive nos; = avendremos, avenirnos)
finca: fincar — it stays, remains (present 3rd sg.; assí finca la boz 'so the plea rests'; = queda; modern fincar is 'to settle on land')
boz: boz — voice; plea, claim at law (fem., Latin vox; assí finca la boz 'so the suit rests'; the legal sense is our reading (?); = voz)
tornaron: tornar — they went back, returned (preterite 3rd pl.; tornaron a la cort 'they went back to the court'; = volvieron)
negar: negar — to deny (infinitive; no lo podemos negar 'we cannot deny it'; = negar)
dárgelas: dar + ge + las — to give them to him (infinitive dar + dative ge (= se, old form of le before lo/la) + las; dárgelas queremos 'we wish to give them to him'; = dárselas)
pusiéronlas: poner + las — they put them (strong preterite 3rd pl. pusieron + enclitic las, accent written; pusiéronlas en mano del rey 'they placed them in the king's hand'; = las pusieron)
relumbra: relumbrar — it shines, gleams (present 3rd sg.; relumbra toda la cort 'the whole court is ablaze with light'; = relumbra, relumbrar)
maçanas: maçana — pommel of a sword, literally 'apple' (fem. pl.; las maçanas e los arriazes 'the pommels and the quillons'; = manzanas, not used for pommel now)
arriazes: arriaz — crossguard, quillons of a sword (masc. pl., Arabic; los arriazes todos d' oro son 'the quillons are all of gold'; = arriaces, arriaz)
tornos: tornar + se — he went back (preterite 3rd sg. tornó + reflexive se, the vowel lost before the s; tornos al escaño 'he went back to the bench'; = se tornó, se volvió)
camear: camear — to change, exchange (infinitive, old variant of cambiar; non las pueden camear 'they cannot swap them'; = cambiar)
alegrósle: alegrar + se + le — it rejoiced in him (preterite 3rd sg. alegró + reflexive se + dative le, accent on the verb; alegrósle tod el cuerpo 'his whole body rejoiced'; = se le alegró)
alçava: alçar — he was raising, he raised (imperfect 3rd sg.; alçava la mano 'he raised his hand'; = alzaba)
nómbrel: nombre + le — name + him (noun nombre with its -e dropped before the enclitic dative le; por nómbrel llamó 'he called him by name'; = por nombre le llamó)
tendió: tender — he stretched out, held out (preterite 3rd sg.; tendió el braço 'he stretched out his arm'; = tendió)
prendetla: prender + la — take it! (imperative 2nd pl. prended + enclitic la, d becoming t before l; Prendetla, sobrino 'take it, nephew'; = prendedla)
mejora: mejorar — it grows better, improves (present 3rd sg.; ca mejora en señor 'for it grows the better in a (good) lord'; the sense is our reading (?); = mejora)
coládal: Colada + le — the sword Colada + 'to him' (el nombre Colada with enclitic dative le, reduced to l; el espada Coládal dio 'he gave him the sword Colada'; = le dio Colada)
ganéla: ganar + la — I won it (preterite 1st sg. gané + enclitic la, accent written; ganéla de buen señor 'I won it from a good lord'; = la gané)
curiedes: curiar — you guard, take care of (present subjunctive 2nd pl., -iedes ending; que la bien curiedes 'that you guard it well'; Latin curare; = cuidéis)
acaeçiere: acaeçer — (if) it befall, happen (future subjunctive 3rd sg.; si vos acaeçiere 'if it befall you'; = acaeciere)

__broaden__.se: se — himself/herself/itself (reflexive pronoun) · also se — passive 'is, are' (cómmo se gana el pan 'how bread is earned'; = se, passive-reflexive) · also se — ethic/intensive dative 'for himself, with his own eyes' (él se lo vío con los ojos 'he saw it himself') · also se — dative 'to him, to them' before lo (= le, old gelo; ca él se lo mandó 'for he had ordered it (of them)', Pidal queries the half-line) · also se — in a split future, partir se a 'will break up, be dissolved' (partir se a la cort 'the court will break up'; partir + se + a (= ha); = se partirá, se disolverá)
__broaden__.partir: partir — to part, separate (infinitive; partir nos emos 'we shall part') · also 'to divide, apportion' (partir tod aqueste aver 'to divide all this wealth') · also partir (se) — 'to break up, be dissolved' (of an assembly; split future partir se a la cort 'the court will be dissolved'; = disolverse, partirse)
__broaden__.quitar: quitar — to leave, quit (infinitive; el reyno quitar 'to quit the kingdom'; = quitar, closest abandonar) · also 'to set free' (quiero las i quitar 'I mean to free them there'; Pidal: 'libertar') · also quitar — to clear, remit (a charge; quitar lo mandava 'he ordered it cleared, i.e. paid or remitted'; quitar gelas 'to clear them for them') · also quitar(se) de — 'to part from, break with' (yo de vos me quiero quitar 'I mean to part company with you'; = separarme de) · also quitar me a — split future quitar + me + a (= ha), 'he will quit, leave' (el que bolviere mi cort quitar me a el reyno 'he who disturbs my court will quit my kingdom', me dative of interest; the exact sense is uncertain (?); = me dejará el reino, tendrá que dejar)
__broaden__.que: que — that, who, which; for · also por que — because, since (= porque) · por que — by which, whereby (por que más valdrá 'whereby he will be worth more') · also que — 'so that, lest' introducing purpose/result (que por miedo non dexen nada; por tal lo faze … que no lo ventasse nadi); after después/mientra 'after, while' (después que, mientra que) · also que — than, after a comparative (mas le vienen … que nos le van 'more come to him than leave him') · also que — what (indirect interrogative; dezir vos he que faze 'I shall tell you what he does'; = qué) · also que — how, exclamative before an adverb (Dios, que bien los sirvió! 'God, how well he served them!'; = qué) · also que — something, what, after aver + infinitive (abrien que ve[er] 'they would have something to see'; = que) · also de que — 'since, from the time that' (de que fu rey 'since I was king'; = desde que)
__broaden__.razón: razón — talk, speech, matter (dexad essa razón 'leave off that talk'; esta razón 'this matter'; = razón, here closest asunto, conversación) · also razón — 'word, voice' (en una razón 'with one voice, in agreement'; = razón) · also razón — fecha por razón 'made with good reason, with purpose' (the cap fitted for a purpose); also dezir mi razón 'state my case' · also razón — 'right, fitting, reasonable' (tod esto es razón 'all this is right'; = razón); acordar la razón 'to settle the matter' (acuerdan la razón 'they agree on their plea')
__broaden__.tiene: tener — he has (present 3rd sg.) · also tener en cuenta — 'he takes account of, counts' (non tiene en cuenta 'he does not keep count'; = tiene en cuenta) · also tener — 'he holds' in the hand (en las manos las tiene 'he holds them in his hands'; = sostiene, tiene)
__broaden__.tomó: tomar — he took (preterite 3rd sg.; a dientes las tomó 'he took them with his teeth'; = tomó) · also tomar — 'he took hold of' (a la barba se tomó 'he took hold of his beard', se ethic; = se tomó, se agarró)
